figurative_meaning_bn: দীর্ঘ অথচ অত্যন্ত কৃশ; অতিশয় রোগা ও দুর্বল ব্যক্তি; ক্ষীণজীবী
figurative_meaning_en: Tall yet extremely thin; an extremely emaciated and weak person; a frail being
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তালপাতার সেপাইয়ের মতো রোগা হয়ে গেছে।
ভাতের অভাবে তার শরীর তালপাতার সেপাইয়ের মতো হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become as thin as a palm leaf soldier.
Due to lack of food, his body has turned into that of a palm leaf soldier.
history: This idiom draws from rural Bengali imagery where palm leaves are thin and fragile, often used in children's play to make toy soldiers, symbolizing something tall but weak and easily breakable.
note: The idiom evokes the visual of a makeshift soldier from a long, slender palm leaf, highlighting vulnerability in Bengali folk expressions.
